request.subject: ICON:ACTION:TORPEDO

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Faction: cheerful, practical storybook medieval. Everything is made of woven cloth, light steel, pale birch wood, cream plaster and beige cobblestone, with stitched hems, steel rivets and carved trims as details; cloth is shaded with a deeper tone of its own colour, steel with darker blue-grey, wood with darker straw yellow, plaster and stone with cool grey, never brown.
layers.negative: gun, musket, rifle, pistol, cannon, gunpowder, top hat, bicorne, tricorne, Napoleonic uniform, modern clothing, steel plate full armour, magic glow, glowing runes, wings, bronze, copper, rust, brown boots, brown leather, dark brown shading, red-brown

layers.text: Class: one bold chunky item sprite with a single clear subject and a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels. The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.
layers.negative: icon frame, round badge, medallion, emblem, coin-shaped backdrop, button, border, circular background, square background, vignette, background scenery, ground tile, grass square, pedestal, many small objects, text, letters, numbers

layers.text: Subject: one big chunky torpedo lying diagonally, nose pointing up and to the right: a long smooth light steel cigar shape with a rounded nose cap in darker blue-grey steel, one pale blue band, four small tail fins and a little propeller at the back, with a short trail of three round white bubbles behind it; only the torpedo and the bubbles; nothing else in the image.
The item is drawn large and fills most of the image.
